full_query: So the singulair is an oral tablet not an inhaler?
sentences: Yes, Singulair (montelukast) is an oral tablet, not an inhaler
It is available in various formulations, including chewable tablets and oral granules, which are intended to be swallowed, not inhaled

snippets.output: Singulair (montelukast) is an oral medication available as tablets, including chewable tablets, and oral granules, all of which are intended to be swallowed rather than inhaled.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of the various oral formulations of the same drug to clarify it is not an inhaler.
